g.text: One fixed first-action intervention, then the original policy replans
Every value is treatment minus control. Only the first saved M/B action disagreement is replaced by B's action.
Target, training fan, technical price and original history remain fixed; future actions follow each branch's own state.
All 11 selected pairs are retained. This is a path intervention, not a new admitted strategy or a population effect.
